title: Generate website-specific QR code

requirements.text: Generate a new QR code image that encodes the actual deployed website URL for Friends AC Services (not the app identifier), optimized for scanning with appropriate size and error correction

quotes: change the qr code and create a specific qr code for this website

acceptanceCriteria: QR code encodes the actual website URL
QR code is scannable and directs users to the live website
Image has sufficient resolution for clear scanning

requirements.text: Update the Footer component (frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx) to display the new website-specific QR code, replacing the current QR code that shows the app identifier

quotes: change the qr code and create a specific qr code for this website

acceptanceCriteria: Footer displays the new QR code image
QR code maintains existing styling and positioning
Label clearly indicates it links to the website

requirements.text: Render the generated website QR code image as a static asset in frontend/public/assets/generated directory for use in the Footer component
acceptanceCriteria: QR code image is saved in frontend/public/assets/generated
Image is properly referenced in Footer component
Asset loads correctly when the page renders

constraints: Do not modify the backend/main.mo file
Maintain existing Footer component layout and styling
Keep all immutable frontend paths unchanged
nonGoals: Changing the Footer component's overall design

required: QR code encoding the Friends AC Services website URL with high error correction and clear contrast (website-qr.dim_300x300.png)
